level_set_reinit — SEGMENTATION contour op

• Data kinds: mask → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.level_set_reinit(phi, *, method: 'str' = 'sussman', n_iter: 'int' = 100, dt: 'float' = 0.5, band: 'float' = 3.0) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import segcontour; segcontour.level_set_reinit(phi, *, method: 'str' = 'sussman', n_iter: 'int' = 100, dt: 'float' = 0.5, band: 'float' = 3.0) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opssegmentation.get("level_set_reinit"))

Usage

Turns φ (inside where φ < 0) into the signed distance function of the same zero level set (level_set_reinit).

method="sussman" = φ_τ + S(φ0)(|∇φ| − 1) = 0 (Sussman–Smereka–Osher 1994) with Godunov upwind differences for n_iter iterations (step dt ≤ 0.5). Grid points touching the interface (sign changes in the 4-neighbourhood) get the subcell fix of Russo–Smereka 2000:

they relax towards D = φ0 / Δφ0 (Δφ0 = the maximum of the central-difference gradient magnitude and the one-sided differences), so the zero level set does not move. method="edt" = signed distance built by distance transform from the mask φ < 0 (2nd implementation; the zero level set is quantised midway between pixel centres and moves by up to half a pixel). Passing a bool mask uses the edt signed distance as φ0.

Returns: phi, grad (10/50/90 % points of |∇φ| where |φ| ≤ band, and the pixel count), grad_before (same, for the input), zero_hausdorff (Hausdorff distance between the zero level sets before and after, pixels), method, n_iter.
